---
title: "rtfreporter: Quality Report"
params:
  out: "out"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
out <- params$out
cov <- if (file.exists(file.path(out, "coverage.rds"))) readRDS(file.path(out, "coverage.rds"))
```

```{r summary, results = "asis"}
# the Quality Report, as validation/trace.R wrote it (the
# environments' table included)
sm <- readLines(file.path(out, "quality-report.md"), encoding = "UTF-8")
cat(sm[-1L], sep = "\n")
gh <- Sys.getenv(c("GITHUB_SERVER_URL", "GITHUB_REPOSITORY", "GITHUB_RUN_ID"))
if (all(nzchar(gh))) {
  cat(sprintf("\nThis report: <%s/%s/actions/runs/%s>; the releases: <%s/%s/releases>.\n",
              gh[1], gh[2], gh[3], gh[1], gh[2]))
}
```

\newpage

# Attachments

## Line coverage by file (an aid)

```{r coverage, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(cov)) {
  cat("Not measured in this run.")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("Total: %.1f%% of the package's lines run under the tests.\n\n", cov$total))
  print(knitr::kable(cov$files[order(cov$files$file), ],
                     col.names = c("File", "Lines", "Covered", "%"), row.names = FALSE))
}
```

## Every environment's sessionInfo and tests' log

In `environments.txt` (attached to the release with this report), one part an
environment of the table above: its full `sessionInfo()` -- R, the OS and every
package's version -- and testthat's own log, ending in
`[ FAIL | WARN | SKIP | PASS ]`.
